about.title: About This Dashboard
about.subtitle: Student Analytics Dashboard — King Saud bin Abdulaziz University for Health Sciences
about.overviewText: This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of student enrollment statistics at King Saud bin Abdulaziz University for Health Sciences (KSAU-HS) across all campuses, colleges, and academic years from 2016/2017 to 2023/2024. It enables administrators and stakeholders to explore trends, compare campuses, drill into college-level data, and gain actionable insights through interactive visualizations.
about.dataSourceText: All data displayed is sourced from the publicly available KSAU-HS student enrollment dataset
about.dataSourceSuffix: The dataset covers three main categories:
about.catGender: Gender — Male and female enrollment per academic year
about.catDegree: Academic Degree — Bachelor's and postgraduate enrollment per year
about.catBranch: Branch & College — Enrollment broken down by campus (Riyadh, Jeddah, Al-Ahsa) and college
about.loadingErrorIntro: Each card independently handles three states:
about.loadingDesc: Loading — A spinner with "Loading data..." appears while data is being fetched
about.errorDesc: Error — If data fails to load, an error message is shown instead of zeros
about.emptyDesc: Empty — If no data exists for the selected filters, a "No data available" message is displayed rather than showing zeros

kpi.title: KPI Cards
kpi.desc: Key performance indicators showing total students, growth rate, female percentage, postgraduate count, and largest campus — all updating in real time with the selected academic year.

trends.title: Student Trends
trends.desc: Line charts visualizing total enrollment and gender breakdown over 8 academic years, with gradient fills and interactive tooltips.

campus.title: Campus Enrollment
campus.desc: Horizontal bar comparison of all three campuses plus a trend chart for the selected campus, with a campus selector filter.

drill.title: Drill-Down Analysis
drill.desc: Horizontal bar chart and detailed table showing per-college enrollment for a selected campus, with percentage share calculations.

heat.title: Advanced Analytics
heat.desc: Top colleges ranking with mini bar charts and a color-coded enrollment heatmap across colleges and academic years, filterable by campus.

dist.title: Enrollment Distribution
dist.desc: Donut chart showing the proportional share of each college in total university enrollment, with a color-coded legend.

insights.title: Insights & Highlights
insights.desc: Automatically generated textual insights highlighting growth trends, gender ratio changes, and postgraduate enrollment milestones.

filters.title: Interactive Filters
filters.desc: Academic year selector in the header and campus selectors in individual cards — all reactive with Angular signals for instant updates.

about.riyadhDesc: 8 colleges: Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Public Health & Health Informatics, Applied Medical Sciences, Science & Health Professions, Postgraduate Medical Education
about.jeddahDesc: 5 colleges: Medicine, Nursing, Applied Medical Sciences, Science & Health Professions, Postgraduate Medical Education
about.alAhsaDesc: 4 colleges: Nursing, Applied Medical Sciences, Science & Health Professions, Postgraduate Medical Education

HERO.TITLE: From Data to Decisions
HERO.SUBTITLE: Student Analytics Dashboard — Turning complex enrollment data into clear, actionable insights for better decision-making.

VALUE.TITLE: From Data to Decisions
VALUE.P1: This platform transforms student enrollment data into an interactive analytics experience that helps decision-makers understand what is happening, where growth is occurring, and where opportunities may exist.
VALUE.P2: Instead of spending hours searching through reports, spreadsheets, historical records, and manually comparing numbers, users can explore the most important information from a single dashboard.

CHALLENGE.TITLE: The Challenge
CHALLENGE.P1: Educational and investment decisions often require analyzing large amounts of historical and demographic data. Finding meaningful patterns manually can require multiple reports, calculations, comparisons, and repeated research.
CHALLENGE.STEP1_DESC: Find information across different reports and datasets.
CHALLENGE.STEP2_DESC: Gather the relevant numbers and historical records.
CHALLENGE.STEP3_DESC: Manually calculate growth rates, percentages, and comparisons.
CHALLENGE.STEP4_DESC: Compare campuses, colleges, demographics, and trends.

SOLUTION.TITLE: The Solution
SOLUTION.P1: The dashboard brings these analytical steps together in one place. It automatically organizes the available data, calculates key indicators, visualizes historical trends, and highlights important patterns.
SOLUTION.STEP1_DESC: All relevant enrollment data in one place.
SOLUTION.STEP2_DESC: Filter and drill down into the data.
SOLUTION.STEP4_DESC: Use the insights to support better decisions.

WHY_MATTERS.TITLE: Why It Matters
WHY_MATTERS.P1: The value of the platform is not simply displaying numbers. It reduces the effort required to understand those numbers and turns raw data into information that can support strategic decisions.
WHY_MATTERS.CARD1_DESC: Reduce the need to search through multiple reports and manually collect information.
WHY_MATTERS.CARD2_DESC: Quickly discover which campuses, colleges, or areas are experiencing the strongest growth.
WHY_MATTERS.CARD3_DESC: Compare campuses, colleges, academic years, and student groups from one interface.
WHY_MATTERS.CARD4_DESC: Turn complex historical data into clear insights that are easier to understand and act upon.

DISCOVER.TITLE: What Can You Discover?
DISCOVER.Q1_DESC: Understand which campuses and colleges have the largest student populations.
DISCOVER.Q2_DESC: Track historical enrollment trends and identify campuses with stronger growth.
DISCOVER.Q3_DESC: Compare college-level enrollment and identify where student demand is concentrated.
DISCOVER.Q4_TITLE: How is the student population changing?
DISCOVER.Q4_DESC: Explore gender distribution, postgraduate participation, and changes across academic years.
DISCOVER.Q5_DESC: Compare Riyadh, Jeddah, and Al-Ahsa using consistent metrics and historical data.
DISCOVER.Q6_DESC: Use visual analytics and generated highlights to quickly identify important changes in the data.

RESEARCH_VS.TITLE: Less Research. Faster Insights.
RESEARCH_VS.P1: Traditional analysis can require several steps before a useful insight is found. This dashboard compresses that process into a single interactive experience.

CAPABILITIES.TITLE: Dashboard Capabilities
CAPABILITIES.SUB: Each capability is designed to answer a specific analytical question and reduce the effort required to extract meaningful information from the data.
CAPABILITIES.KPI_DESC: Key performance indicators showing total students, growth rate, female percentage, postgraduate count, and largest campus — all updating in real time with the selected academic year.
CAPABILITIES.TRENDS_DESC: Line charts visualizing total enrollment and gender breakdown over 8 academic years, with gradient fills and interactive tooltips.
CAPABILITIES.CAMPUS_DESC: Horizontal bar comparison of all three campuses plus a trend chart for the selected campus, with a campus selector filter.
CAPABILITIES.DRILL_DESC: Horizontal bar chart and detailed table showing per-college enrollment for a selected campus, with percentage share calculations.
CAPABILITIES.HEAT_DESC: Top colleges ranking with mini bar charts and a color-coded enrollment heatmap across colleges and academic years, filterable by campus.
CAPABILITIES.DIST_DESC: Donut chart showing the proportional share of each college in total university enrollment, with a color-coded legend.
CAPABILITIES.INSIGHTS_DESC: Automatically generated textual insights highlighting growth trends, gender ratio changes, and postgraduate enrollment milestones.
CAPABILITIES.FILTERS_DESC: Academic year selector in the header and campus selectors in individual cards — all reactive with Angular signals for instant updates.

COVERAGE.P1: The dashboard analyzes publicly available KSAU-HS student enrollment data across multiple academic years, campuses, colleges, academic degrees, and demographic categories.
